agent_notes: The canonical parent domain https://www.mpuat.ac.in/ was established through official constituent-college pages and search discovery, but direct HTTPS GETs returned HTTP 403, so the central university catalogue could not be audited.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; after confirming the official/search hostnames, public GETs used curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

Current official constituent catalogues were reachable at CTAE and CCAS. RCA's HTTPS endpoint returned an empty reply and its public catalogue was reachable only over HTTP, so RCA-derived entries require manual review.

CTAE's official Academic Programs overview says 8 undergraduate branches, 12 M.Tech disciplines and 9 Ph.D. disciplines, while current department course pages expose Artificial Intelligence & Data Science and an additional Civil Ph.D. entry; this internal catalogue inconsistency is preserved for manual review.

The parent university's College of Dairy and Food Technology and any other inaccessible constituent-college catalogues could not be verified from a live official page in this run; this course list must not be treated as complete.

Course mappings were produced from read-only queries against assets/data/career_path.db; nearest-parent and closest-specialization relations are explicitly labelled where the local career tree has no exact course label.
